commits.message:
docs(evidence): reconcile the C10-C13/CG1 manifest rows and the capability-reconciliation CG1 claim onto the measured 2026-08-17/18 basis (#479)

Re-derive the five §8.1 control-plane rows on measured output (v1.1.23
literals, measured counts with 2026-08-05 contracts retained as
superseded provenance, blocked chains converted to measured readiness),
anchor CG1's row to its now-built gate, and decorate the 2026-08-04 bare
CG1 PASS with dated provenance. Records the newly surfaced, attributed,
CI-unwired capability-reconciliation verifier red (stale per-task
citation pins) for the follow-up re-pin.
ci(evidence): scope the CG1 stale-blueprint-pin mutations to checkouts that carry the gitignored blueprint (#479)
ci(evidence): make the CG1 self-test mirror the CI blueprint-optional invocation when the gitignored blueprint is absent (#479)
ci(evidence): wire the CG1 fit gate and self-test, with a blueprint-optional mode for the gitignored-blueprint checkout (#479)

feat(demo,evidence): build the CG1 aggregate control-publication fit gate — 34-validator roster measured under the 16,384-byte envelope (#479)

The gate CG1's manifest row always named but never received: a verifier
that recomputes the hub/control publication roster from
nodeRuntimeReferenceScriptTargets and fails closed on drift, a pinned
evidence artifact carrying per-validator applied hash, script bytes,
complete signed publication transaction bytes, fee, and margin (all 34
fit; largest 13,317 bytes), the oversized CEK direct resolver as the one
cited exclusion tracked by P1, a PRE_FREEZE hash basis naming #510's
regeneration as the re-pin trigger, and a self-test rejecting 25 hostile
mutations.
docs(ledger): record the first direct #479 measurement — C10-C13 PASS, CG1 blocked on its never-built aggregate verifier (#479)
docs(ledger): record the static-policy PASS under the declared compiler, closing #476 criterion 5 (#476)

docs(evidence,demo): retire the nine C20 citation defects onto the #587 gate and ledger the #477 all-PASS measurement (#476, #477, #587)

The nine C20-0..C20-8 rows cited a focused module that was never written
because #587 retired its subject; re-point them to the named replacement
gate, re-derive their contracts from measured runs, empty the standing
accepted-defect enumeration with dated retirement records, and teach the
quality gate's --accepted-defects loader that an empty enumeration is
valid and allowlists nothing. Ledger the #477 (C28) acceptance
re-measurement (all five criteria PASS at e1e65629, sole red the accepted
#597 carriage-selection gap) and supersede the stale C28 row in place.

fix(demo): move the goldens Golden type onto the post-#606 certificate shape

16c375c0a's #606 off-chain repair updated the generator, the fixture, and
the two certificate test blocks to the constant asset name and the
mint-welded fieldHashHex, but left the test file's Golden type declaring
the retired per-certificate plural asset-name class - breaking
midgard-core's tsc --noEmit while the suite itself stayed green (vitest
does not typecheck). The type now matches what the generator emits:
singular constant certificateAssetName and tier3Certificate.fieldHashHex.
Type-only; goldens suite 11/11, full midgard-core 507/507, tsc clean.

docs(onchain): record the sentinel-repair decision on the residual notes

The empty-trie sentinel translation for the published-chunk route was
owner-approved on 2026-08-17 to execute inside #510's single freeze-event
regeneration, including the insert_root fold-in. The three surfaces that
recorded the residual as undecided move onto the decision: mpf-proof-v1's
does_not_have doc-comment no longer says a follow-up ticket is awaited,
chunked-inclusion-v1's module header drops the self-referential claim
that #582 gates the repair, and the readiness prerequisite names the
approval instead of a pending ticket. Comment/doc changes only — no
compiled code moves.

fix(demo): model the deployed post-#597 shapes in the proof-item envelope measurement script

The producer behind the superseded 8,273 selector basis still built the
retired 5-field proof-item datum (collectionProof embedded) and passed a
2-field tag-30 auxiliary as the direct Verify action's fourth field. Move
both to the deployed ABI (4-field ValidationProofItemDatumV1; Inline
FieldCarriageV1 as the action's own carriage field) and drop the dead
collection-proof scaffolding. Fresh run against the current blueprint:
publication frontier 15,569 exact / 15,072 reliable (was 14,892/14,396),
by-reference frontier 15,172 exact / 14,676 reliable (was 14,494/13,998),
reference route byte-identical as the internal control. No parameter or
pin moves: the 8,273 direct-route bound stays where it is pending the
open owner decision, and P7's retired-shape pins remain as history. The
consensus-profile suite's stale 13,998 comment now carries both readings;
suite green 7/7.

docs(evidence): re-derive four more necessity artifacts onto the flat FieldCarriageV1 scheme (#580)

Apply the transaction-field-chunk template to redeemer-item-traversal,
mint-fold-asset, native-script-traversal, and ledger-output-incremental-
proof: new flat-scheme measurement sections sourced from eight producing
suites (42/42 green against the digest-verified blueprint), counted-era
content retained verbatim under invariant-14 SUPERSEDED headings, known
#606/#611 movements cited by reference rather than re-pinned, and every
necessity conclusion re-derived same-direction on each family's own
post-authentication structural axis. script-source-hash-block-v1.md is
deliberately untouched: its dissolution notice contradicts live tree
state (ScriptSourceHashBlockWitness machinery present continuously since
2d7151d38, in the current blueprint, actively produced) — escalated for
owner adjudication rather than edited. Ledger entry records the campaign
closure and the escalation.

docs(evidence): re-derive the transaction-field-chunk necessity artifact onto the flat FieldCarriageV1 scheme (#580)

Replace the counted-era TransactionFieldChunkWitness analysis with a
flat-scheme re-derivation measured against the four producing suites
(all green this pass): tier-1 Inline with the #611 signed-transaction
falsification carried in both postures, tier-2 RawUtxo at the unmoved
K=15,148/15,644 frontier, the 64-byte overhang per P7's ruling, and
tier-3 Certified with the post-#606 combined lower bound (16,613 B,
210-B certificate datum, 2,064,490 lovelace min-Ada) reported against
the stale P7 pins rather than averaged. The counted-era sections are
retained verbatim under a SUPERSEDED notice per GOAL_SPEC invariant 14.
Conclusion re-derived same-direction: preimages above K still require
tier-3 carriage; the internal bounded chunk walk survives as machine-
trace structure plus tier-3's real K-byte boundary.

docs(evidence,ledger): re-take the owed CEK direct-resolver publication receipt on the cleared selector (#580 residual)

The #597 staging-lane repair restored the producing selector, so the
receipt superseded since #580 is measured again: 162,660 signed bytes,
L1 margin -146,276, against the f49cae22 blueprint whose identity is
pinned by 5010a2bf's commit message and reproduced byte-identically by
a scratch fork build from HEAD. Framing is unchanged at 515 bytes; the
movement is entirely the resolver body. Also sharpens the ledger's
acceptance record: the four dispute-submit reds were owner-accepted in
#608's red map, so 9f191e9a retired an accepted red class.

docs(evidence,ledger): reconcile the C21 row and ledger onto the flat-scheme measured tree (#597)

Re-pin the C21 manifest contract from the 2026-08-17 re-measure at
9f191e9a (6 Aiken + 11 validation + 5 SDK + 21 fault-proofs = 43, 42
passing, one attributed owner-gated red) with the superseded 2026-08-05
contract retained verbatim, and re-measure all five sourceAnchors.
Append the dated ledger entry recording the equivalence-audit and
selector reconciliations, the #597 wire-twin gap attribution and fix,
the open observe-stage reference-script liveness decision, and the
pre-existing Q02 scanner red.
